name: Lanterns at Dusk
code:
// LANTERNS AT DUSK - an original quiet-world ambient loop
// Soft bells, warm chords, and plenty of space. No downloaded samples.
// Ctrl+Enter / RUN to play. Ctrl+. / STOP to stop.
// Each chord lasts two cycles; the whole phrase lasts about 27 seconds.
// Customize: change 72 for tempo, or lower a layer's gain to make it quieter.

setcpm(72/4)

// Little lanterns: a sparse, original bell melody.
$: note("<[e5 ~ g5 d5 ~ b4 ~ g4] [a4 ~ c5 e5 ~ b4 ~ e4] [a4 ~ g4 c5 ~ e5 ~ c5] [d5 ~ b4 a4 ~ g4 ~ d5]>")
  .slow(2)
  .s("sine")
  .attack(0.01)
  .release(0.8)
  .room(0.35)
  .gain(0.17)

// A soft blanket: Cmaj7, Am7, Fmaj7, then a suspended G chord.
// Commas play notes together. Angle brackets change the chord each cycle.
$: note("<[c4,e4,g4,b4] [a3,c4,e4,g4] [f3,a3,c4,e4] [g3,c4,d4,a4]>")
  .slow(2)
  .s("triangle")
  .attack(1)
  .release(2)
  .lpf(1200)
  .room(0.45)
  .gain(0.035)

// Quiet footsteps: one low note underneath each chord.
$: note("<c2 a1 f2 g2>")
  .slow(2)
  .s("sine")
  .attack(0.2)
  .release(1)
  .gain(0.13)

// Stars: occasional high notes. The ~ symbols leave silence.
$: note("<~ [~ ~ e6 ~] ~ [~ d6 ~ ~]>")
  .slow(2)
  .s("sine")
  .attack(0.01)
  .release(1.2)
  .room(0.45)
  .gain(0.035)
